scientific_integrity: New: exact periodic-point zeta and recurrence, two maximal-entropy phases, and digit frequencies. Previously known: forbidden-pattern classification and supergolden exponential growth. Self-review only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Full two-sided binary shift permitting only antisquares 01 and 10; period counts are for labeled shift-fixed points. The proof uses published minimal-antisquare and exceptional-word classifications. Neither unrestricted larger antisquare sets nor all invariant measures are classified. The computational certificate checks the finite presentation and algebra, not those published theorems.
title: Two maximal-entropy phases and an exact periodic-orbit law for antisquare-good binary shifts
